spec: wiki Methods/'Method - Qi fixes training screen' (2026-10-18). User: 'Try training the model with these modifications'.
model: generative predictor of pred_gpc.py (stage 1): residual top-down maps, zero start, T=400, T2=100, 4000 steps, batch 256, unit precision, rule pc, seed 0

arms_per_depth.spklit1: spike=lit1 (step 1 on hidden level j at t=j), base c=2 (stage-1 selection)
arms_per_depth.spkstable: spike=stable: base c=0.1, wavefront step scale c_spike=2.0 (hidden j at t=j, s at t=H); Qi's small-step + spike regime in curvature-normalised units
arms_per_depth.c01: control for spkstable: c=0.1, no spike

controls_reused: stage-1 seed 0 (findings/21): plain PC d3 0.381 / d10 0.375; BP auto-decoder d3 0.306 / d10 0.278. Default code path is gated equal to the pre-change code.
no_selection: no step-scale sweep for the new arms (fixed by design); divergence retries at c/2, c/4 as before; flagged

readings.primary: test k_seen k=1 nmse at T=400 vs plain PC on the same depth (seed 0; one seed: differences under ~0.005 are not interpretable)
readings.depth: d10 vs d3 within each arm
readings.spike: spkstable vs c01 isolates the spike

prior_evidence: diag_c4 (inference-only on trained decoders) predicted both fixes fail; this tests whether training with them changes that
